scope: M03-P03-IP-002 Cloud Billing regional-pack tax-invoice runtime validation
implementation_summary: Added a provider-neutral CloudBillingTaxInvoiceFormatPolicy mapping supported regional packs to the OpenAPI-documented tax invoice formats for KR, JP, EU, IN, BR, KSA, and UAE.

generate_cloud_billing_invoice_from_api now rejects account/invoice regional-pack mismatch, unsupported regional packs, and tax invoice formats detached from the selected regional pack before issuing an invoice.
Updated IP-002 plan status and acceptance commands to reflect the current workspace gates and the remaining metering/runtime boundaries.
Kept the slice cloud-provider agnostic and self-host/on-prem/colo compatible: no cloud SDKs, external tax authority calls, network I/O, or provider-specific billing dependencies were added.

verification.evidence: New regional-pack tax-format tests failed with Created instead of BadRequest, proving the missing runtime policy before implementation.

Cloud billing tax app tests passed 6/6, covering documented status codes, successful invoice generation, regional-pack tax-format mapping, pack mismatch, invalid format, and unsupported pack rejection.
Rustfmt applied to changed tax app crate/tests.
Targeted tax app clippy passed with warnings denied.

notes: Correctness: tests now cover successful invoice generation plus region-pack mismatch, unsupported pack, and wrong format rejection paths.
Architecture: regional tax format policy remains a pure app/runtime boundary table and does not bind the billing API to any cloud provider.
Security/privacy: no secrets, network calls, or external tax-provider payloads are introduced; financial tax registration remains in the existing response/request shape.
Maintainability: the mapping is explicit and mirrors the contract enum rather than spreading ad hoc regional checks through invoice generation.
Queue/merge discipline: open PR only after local gates; wait for oya-pr-review and required checks before next-queue/automerge.

known_gaps.reason: This ChangeSet does not add a deployed outbox, event publisher, or persistent metering ingestion runtime.
The app still validates idempotency key presence but does not persist fingerprints across requests.
No external tax authority or provider-specific billing service is called in this provider-neutral slice.
No deployed HTTP/router wiring is introduced; this proves the runtime function and contract-bound tests only.

rollback: Revert this ChangeSet to remove the regional-pack tax-format policy, plan/evidence status updates, and audit-chain rows; no provider or external tax state rollback is required because this slice performs no network or provider side effects.

findings: Regional pack to tax invoice format is now enforced at runtime and covered by regression tests.
Pure tests require no cloud credentials, tax authority credentials, or network access.
No cloud SDK/provider-specific dependency was introduced; the policy is provider-neutral and region-pack driven.
The mapping mirrors the OpenAPI tax_invoice_format enum while preserving the existing runtime binding surface.
The implementation is a small explicit mapping plus admission checks, avoiding hidden ad hoc cases.
No secrets, network I/O, or new external data flows were added.
Supported region packs are centralized in one policy type and regression-tested as contract vocabulary.
Unsupported regional packs fail before invoice issuance with stable error codes.
Phase/IP status, FD001 evidence, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain rows are attached.
